title: Kill Narfi
description: A Dark Brotherhood side contract given by Nazir. The player must travel to Ivarstead and assassinate the beggar Narfi, then return to Nazir at the Sanctuary for a leveled gold reward.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin and the Dark Brotherhood's primary contract giver for small side jobs.
I offer three contracts at once: Narfi, Beitild, and Ennodius Papius. The order does not matter.
I pay leveled gold upon completion of each contract.

CONTRACT_ACCEPTED: I have given the player the contract to kill the beggar Narfi in Ivarstead.
NARFI_KILLED: The player has killed Narfi and should report back to me for payment.
QUEST_COMPLETED: I have paid the player a leveled gold reward for assassinating Narfi, ranging from 250 to 750 septims depending on their level.
I sarcastically remarked to the player, 'Congratulations. You slaughtered an emaciated beggar in cold blood. You are truly an opponent to be feared.'
The player has successfully completed one of the three initial side contracts I provided.

base_facts: I am a hapless beggar living in ruined house by the creek outside Ivarstead.
I am broken and confused. My sister Reyda is gone and I miss her.

CONTRACT_ACCEPTED: Someone in the Dark Brotherhood wants me dead.
NARFI_KILLED: I have been killed by the Dark Brotherhood's assassin.

beats.comment: Player accepts the side contract from Nazir to kill Narfi. Quest stage 10 fires.
Narfi has been killed. Quest advances to stage 20; player must report back to Nazir.
Player reports back to Nazir and collects the leveled gold reward. Quest finishes at stage 200.
